title: Little dragon holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 42 Q68 55 58 68' stroke='#aaaaaa' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='28' rx='14' ry='17' fill='#ff3366'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='28' rx='14' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ff6699' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='22' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff99bb' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M60 45 L63 42 L66 45 Z' fill='#ff3366'/>
  <!-- Dragon body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='70' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#44cc77'/>
  <!-- Dragon belly -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='74' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#aaffcc'/>
  <!-- Dragon head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='13' fill='#44cc77'/>
  <!-- Dragon snout -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='54' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#55ddaa'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#226644'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='55' r='1.2' fill='#226644'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='47' r='2' fill='#113322'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='46.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='53' y1='48' x2='60' y2='46' stroke='#33aa66' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='50' x2='61' y2='51' stroke='#33aa66' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <path d='M36 40 L33 32 L39 37 Z' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <path d='M46 39 L48 30 L51 38 Z' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <path d='M53 44 Q60 40 57 47 Z' fill='#33bb66'/>
  <!-- Arm reaching for balloon -->
  <path d='M52 65 Q58 60 60 55' stroke='#44cc77' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Claws -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <!-- Other arm -->
  <path d='M28 68 Q24 64 25 60' stroke='#44cc77' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d='M34 82 Q32 90 28 92' stroke='#44cc77' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M46 82 Q48 90 52 92' stroke='#44cc77' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='92' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#33aa66'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='92' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#33aa66'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M22 72 Q12 74 10 66 Q8 58 14 55' stroke='#44cc77' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Tail spade -->
  <path d='M14 55 Q10 50 16 51 Q12 47 18 49 Q16 46 20 50 Z' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <!-- Spines on back -->
  <path d='M30 58 L27 52 L33 56 Z' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <path d='M34 55 L32 48 L38 53 Z' fill='#ffaa33'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#ff8888' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
